sources.title: Run Parakeet 0.6B GGUF Locally: Private ASR Tutorial — AI Tutorial
sources.snippet: Look for the file named parakeet-unified-en-.6b-gguf or similar, typically ending in .gguf. Click the download icon to save the file to your local machine. Note that this is a quantized model, meaning it has been compressed to run efficiently on consumer hardware with minimal loss in accuracy. Ensure you have at least 2-4GB of free disk space.
